description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractWell for a family of pseudo-random number generators based on the WELL algorithm. It includes seed initialization, internal state management, and related utilities, and is part of the org.apache.commons.math3.random package.

classes.name: AbstractWell
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the WELL family of pseudo-random number generators, parameterized by algorithm-specific parameters and seed.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Reinitializes the generator with a single int seed, resetting internal state accordingly.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Reinitializes the generator with an int array seed; if null, seed based on system time and identity hash code is used.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Reinitializes the generator with a long seed, converting it into an int array.
